pr_title: network: set routes to DNS servers provided by DHCP
pr_body:
Closes #11961.

Currently, only DNS servers provided by DHCPv4 are supported. If this is accepted, then I will do that for DHCPv6 in later PR.
pr_comments: @poettering Thank you for the review. I force-pushed a revised version. PTAL.
@keszybz Thank you for the review. I've force-pushed a revised version. In the revised version, the two suggestions (hash_ops and helper func) by @keszybz are addressed. PTAL.
Hmm, setting SetRoutesToDNS=yes by default seems to break Ubuntu CIs.
Updated. Now the setting is disabled by default.
Now all CIs are green. PTAL.

issue_context.title: networkd: synthesize explicit per-ip routes from DHCP lease DNS data
issue_context.body: I think it would make a lot of sense if networkd would synthesize routes from DNS server data included in DHCP leases, thus ensuring that IP traffic to these servers goes via the iface the lease was acquired on. (after all, without configuratoin of metrics more focussed routes win over less focussed ones...). Prompted by #11935.

review_comments: maybe use dns_route_present_in_routes() here too, to not generate such a route if there already is an explicit one in the lease? should be easy to add, given you already have the function but should make this more robust i think.
